observations.body: Suffering and entrusted testimony are guarded through the Spirit. Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God, That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.

payload.tension: The passage states suffering and entrusted testimony are guarded through the Spirit. Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God, That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.
